aiUseRate.unit: % of U.S. businesses using AI in any business function (national rate)
aiUseRate.period: BTOS collection period ending May 3, 2026 (AI use hovered 17%-20%, Dec 14, 2025-May 3, 2026)
aiUseRate.source: U.S. Census Bureau, 'Large Firms With at Least 20 Employees Biggest AI Users', page last revised May 22, 2026 (census.gov/library/stories/2026/05/ai-use-businesses.html)

aiUseLargeFirms.unit: % of firms with 250+ employees reporting AI use
aiUseLargeFirms.period: within the Dec 14, 2025-May 3, 2026 review (exact collection period not stated)

aiUseSmallestFirms.unit: % of firms with 1-4 employees reporting AI use ('less than 20%')

noHeadcountChange.unit: % (roughly) of AI-using firms reporting no change in total employment over the prior six months
noHeadcountChange.source: Minneapolis Fed, 'AI adoption in business grows steadily but unevenly', May 29, 2026 (reporting Census BTOS AI supplement; original table not opened)

notes: BTOS changed its AI question in Nov 2025 (production use -> any business function); do not compare with earlier rates.

Refresh check 2026-11-26: Census BTOS Nov 5 and Nov 19, 2026 release pages still could not be fetched (client error), so 19.8% (period ending May 3, 2026) remains the newest verified rate. No figures changed.
Scene 3 numbers are illustrative, not data.
